context: AND ADMINISTRATION Acute coronary syndrome ( 2.1 ) Initiate clopidogrel tablets with a single 300-mg oral loading dose and then continue at 75 mg once daily. Initiating clopidogrel tablets without a loading dose will delay establishment of an antiplatelet effect by several days Recent
